reviews.title: 12-hour collection with chronological limit replay
reviews.summary: Switch from ten-minute snapshots to 12-hour checks. Use complete timestamped trade history to estimate fills at or through resting limits, capped at 5% qualifying volume. Preserve all previously recorded fills and losses.
decisions: REVISE: new trades use limit-replay-v2. Existing open trades retain their original entry version; subsequent replay fills carry execution model touch-volume-v2.
REPLAY: reconstruct entry before a contingent exit in the same interval, respect expiry and holding cutoffs, and retain checkpoints if history is incomplete. No OHLC-only fill inference.
MONITOR: time exits, loss triggers and immediate-execution positions still use observed order books; delayed exits are logged rather than fabricated.
REVIEW IN TWO DAYS: reduce to 8-hour checks if the slower cadence causes incomplete history, stale checks, or material exit delays. Do not judge cadence from two days of profits.

health.note: 12-hour snapshot collection with chronological resting-limit replay. Market stops/time exits require observed books; GitHub schedules may be delayed.

diagnostics.method: 2,000 event-cluster bootstrap resamples; 95% percentile interval; minimum 20 event blocks. Not adjusted for cross-event correlation or multiple comparisons. Worst-tail mean uses lowest 5% of trade returns and is descriptive, not a forecast. No annualized Sharpe for this short trial.
